verdict.rationale: Mistral documents that some models (e.g. Mistral 7B, Mistral Small 4) are released as open-weight under Apache 2.0, with a dedicated 'Model weights' page and per-model cards listing licenses and download links — this is the closest analog to 'open source' for an LLM provider. However, this is only a subset of the lineup; flagship/production models require a commercial license, and there is no evidence of open training code, infrastructure, or full source availability beyond weights. Missing for 10: full training/inference source code openness, independent confirmation that weights match documented licenses, and clarity on which models (vs. proprietary ones) are actually open.
